title: Look
sub: Show me a letter or a screen. I'll point at what matters and add it to your case.
openingDoc: Opening the letter from your case…
toolMosSub: Every form field in order, from your case
toolVisitSub: What to bring, from official pages
errImageOpen: That image could not be opened.
captureCopy: Letters, MOS screens, UPO receipts, inPOL status and ticket kiosks.
dropHint: Or drop an image here, or paste a screenshot.
samplesIntro: Realistic test documents for a fictional student, Arjun Raman. Case number, people and addresses are made up. They go through the same live models as your own photos.
via_deliveredHelp: The date the postman or office gave it to you, or you signed for it.
via_noticeHelp: The date on the first notice slip. Uncollected letters count as delivered 14 days later.
via_electronicHelp: The date the message arrived in your e-Doręczenia inbox.
saveFailed: Could not save to your case.
noTime: No time printed; check the letter.
fromLetterDate: The deadline counts from the date on the letter, {date}.
viaQuestion: How did this letter reach you?
dateNotice: Date on the first notice slip
addSub: Check what I read. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
hintFind: Finding the case number and dates…
hintAsks: Looking for what they ask you to do…
notInCase: Not in your case yet. Take it from your passport or documents.
countedBy: Counted by {rule}. Computed in code from the letter's wording, not guessed by a model.

errSample: Could not load the sample image.
